ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, line AB and CD intersect at point O, with OA bisecting $\angle EOC$. If $\angle EOC = 70^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $\angle BOD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} \\
$\because$ OA bisects $\angle EOC$, \\
$\therefore \angle AOC= \frac{1}{2}\angle EOC$, \\
$\because \angle EOC=70^\circ$, \\
$\therefore \angle AOC= \frac{1}{2}\times 70^\circ=35^\circ$, \\
$\because$ Straight lines AB and CD intersect at point O, \\
$\therefore \angle BOD=\angle AOC=\boxed{35^\circ}$.
